default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-119.title: Higher-timeframe trend, EMA reclaim entry
E-119.hypothesis: Trade only in the direction of the long moving average of hourly closes (the post: 100 EMA on 1H; here the 50/100-hour simple mean); enter when price closes back across a short EMA in that direction.

E-120.title: VWAP wick rejection on heavy volume
E-120.hypothesis: Not the first touch: a bar that pierces the session VWAP, leaves a long wick and closes back on its side with volume well above normal for the minute shows larger players defending the level; trade the bounce.

E-121.title: First-hour trend lock
E-121.hypothesis: The direction of the first 30-60 minutes sets the day; afterwards only trade in that direction, entering when price closes back across a short EMA.

E-122.title: Broken parabolic (engulfing after a run)
E-122.hypothesis: After several bars in a row of one colour, the first engulfing bar the other way marks exhaustion; fade it.

E-123.title: RSI exhaustion reversal
E-123.hypothesis: RSI at an extreme (80-90+ or below 10-20) stretches the rubber band; the first bar that closes against the move starts the snap back.

E-124.title: Volume spike without movement, follow the drift
E-124.hypothesis: A bar with very high volume but a small range during a slow grind is a large player filling orders (refill); trade with the grind's direction.

E-125.title: Opening-range rip and dip
E-125.hypothesis: In the first two hours, a break of the opening range, a one-bar dip, then a close back above the dip bar's high continues the break (mirror for shorts).

E-126.title: Flag fake breakdown
E-126.hypothesis: After an impulse, a flag forms; the first poke beyond the flag against the impulse that closes back inside traps the breakout sellers and the real move follows the impulse.

E-127.title: Opening reversal (the '9:45' reversal at B3's open)
E-127.hypothesis: Early-session moves overshoot; 15-45 minutes after the open, fade a move from the open larger than usual for that time of day.
